summary:
Double free when reinitializing name constraints fails on allocation.
The fix, 95256a91 (3.8.14), names 22cba2f "x509/name_constraints: rework
with rbtree-list" (first released in 3.8.13) as the commit that
introduced it: it clears the gl_list pointers that rework added.
3.8.9-3+deb13u4 has no gl_list in lib/x509/name_constraints.c: its
lists are plain arrays, and name_constraints_node_list_clear() frees
them without allocating, then sets data/sorted_view to NULL and size to
0. The fix does not apply to this source. Re-evaluate if this spec is
rebased to 3.8.13.
